judgment.rationale: The Environment Variables launch failure has moved past the initial missing-info state: multiple public comments now describe CJK-language reproduction and attach bug reports, so it is ready for full design investigation.
evidence: Issue body: Environment Variables opens to a black window and closes after about three seconds on PowerToys v0.101.2222.
Reporter confirmed the tool works after switching language to English and fails when using Chinese.
Another tester reported reliable reproduction on v0.101.2242 with zh-CN and ja-JP while en-US and ru-RU are normal, and attached a PowerToysReport ZIP.
judgment.recommended_action: Run full issue-to-design investigation using the public reports and language matrix, without claiming a root cause in this fast pass.
